definitions: A psychological study designed to investigate the phenomenon of deindividuation, where individuals lose their sense of self-awareness and personal responsibility in a group setting.
An experimental setup used to observe how anonymity, group size, and arousal influence individual behavior, often leading to impulsive or deviant actions.
examples: The results of the deindividuation experiment were surprising.
Researchers conducted a deindividuation experiment to understand crowd behavior.
A classic deindividuation experiment involved participants wearing masks.
